question: For courses offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, where the number of enrolled students exceeds the average for Mathematics department courses in the same academic year, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number. For each such course, also show the name of the degree-granting department, the subject code, the subject code description, and the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code, listing the columns in this order: course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, row number, department name, subject code, subject code description, average ASCII value of course number, and variance of ASCII value of course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
answer:
# Final Report

## 1. Entity Semantics

**Tables**
- **LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED** — Subjects offered per term appearing in library reserve processing. Key columns: `COURSE_NUMBER`, `SUBJECT_TITLE`, `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`, `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` (e.g. 'Mathematics'), `TERM_CODE`, `SUBJECT_ID`. Granularity: one row per subject per term in library scope.
- **ACADEMIC_TERMS** — Term dimension: `TERM_CODE`, `TERM_DESCRIPTION`, `ACADEMIC_YEAR`, term status attributes. One row per term.
- **SIS_SUBJECT_CODE** — Subject-code lookup: `SUBJECT_CODE` (e.g. '18'), `COURSE_NUMBER`, `SUBJECT_CODE_DESC`, `DEPARTMENT_CODE`, `DEPARTMENT_NAME`. One row per subject code/course number.
- **SIS_DEPARTMENT** — Department dimension: `DEPARTMENT_CODE`, `DEPARTMENT_NAME`, `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` ('Y'/'N'), school attribution.
- **SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION** — Catalog course descriptions with degree-granting flag; joins via `COURSE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER`.
- **SUBJECT_SUMMARY / SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY / SUBJECT_OFFERED / COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED / TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED / STUDENT_DEPARTMENT / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL** — alternative subject-offering fact/dimension tables investigated as candidates (details in Section 3).

**Metrics (precedents)**
- **dw_4584** — Exact same first-half shape: Mathematics library courses with ≥5 enrolled, row number per academic year by course number, enrollment > yearly average. SQL confirmed: `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ⋈ ACADEMIC_TERMS`, `OFFER_DEPT_NAME='Mathematics'`, `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS>=5`, `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER)`, AvgEnrolled CTE grouped by ACADEMIC_YEAR.
- **dw_4812** — Degree-granting department + subject code stats joined to library `COURSE_NUMBER` via `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER`, matching `DEPARTMENT_NAME = OFFER_DEPT_NAME`.
- **dw_3356 / dw_4490** — `SIS_DEPARTMENT (IS_DEGREE_GRANTING='Y') ⋈ SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` pattern with `VARIANCE()`/`SUBJECT_CODE_DESC`.
- **dw_3969** — `AVG(ASCII(...))` precedent for ASCII-value aggregation.
- **dw_2398, dw_2210, dw_1393, dw_4527, dw_4658** — additional Mathematics/subject-code/enrollment-dispersion precedents confirming table roles.

**Concepts / Column Concepts**
- **concept_subject_offering_facts** — documents that only LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED carries `COURSE_NUMBER`/`COURSE_NUMBER_DESC` among offering tables.
- **column_concept_enrollment_measures** — decision guide: "number of enrolled students" → `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`; official registrar enrollment → `SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`.
- **column_concept_department_name** — `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` (library/TIP/offered) vs `DEPARTMENT_NAME` (summary/catalog/lookup) share the academic value domain.
- **concept_department_dimension**, **concept_academic_term_dimension**, **column_concept_subject_id**, **column_concept_term_code** — confirm join keys (`TERM_CODE`, `DEPARTMENT_CODE`, `SUBJECT_ID`).

## 2. Lineage & Relationships
- dw_4584 lineage: LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED → ACADEMIC_TERMS (TERM_CODE); TIME_DAY (not needed here).
- dw_4812 lineage: SIS_DEPARTMENT → SIS_SUBJECT_CODE (DEPARTMENT_CODE); LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.COURSE_NUMBER → SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER.
- SIS_SUBJECT_CODE has 37 dependent metrics (retrieved via `metrics_by_table`), all using it for subject-code/description resolution joined to SIS_DEPARTMENT via DEPARTMENT_CODE.

## 3. Similar-Entity Differences

**3a. Dimension matrix (enrollment source candidates)**

| Dimension | LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED | SUBJECT_SUMMARY | SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY | TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grain | subject/term, library scope | subject-or-cluster/term | subject/term | subject/term, TIP scope |
| "Course number" column | `COURSE_NUMBER` ✔ (concept_subject_offering_facts: distinctive attribute) | ✘ (SUBJECT_ID only) | ✔ COURSE_NUMBER | ✘ |
| "Number of enrolled students" | `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS` ✔ | `SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER` (official registrar) | both | `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS` |
| Department filter | `OFFER_DEPT_NAME='Mathematics'` ✔ (dw_4584 precedent) | `DEPARTMENT_NAME` | `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` | `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` |

**3b. Task-Requirement Fitness**
- COURSE_NUMBER output: LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED SUPPORTED; SUBJECT_SUMMARY NOT-SUPPORTED (no such column per retrieved columns).
- NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ≥5 + > yearly average: SUPPORTED on LIBRARY (dw_4584 identical precedent); SUPPORTED technically on others but wording "number of enrolled students" maps to NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS per column_concept_enrollment_measures decision guide.
- TERM_DESCRIPTION/ACADEMIC_YEAR: ACADEMIC_TERMS SUPPORTED (both columns exist).
- Degree-granting department name, subject code, subject code description: SIS_DEPARTMENT + SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SUPPORTED (IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC all exist).
- AVG/VARIANCE of ASCII(COURSE_NUMBER) per subject code: SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SUPPORTED (has COURSE_NUMBER + SUBJECT_CODE; ASCII precedent dw_3969, VARIANCE precedent dw_3356).

**3c. Wording-to-Field Anchoring**
- "courses offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students… course number, subject title, number of enrolled students" → lexically identical to dw_4584's wording, which anchors to LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.COURSE_NUMBER/SUBJECT_TITLE/NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS/OFFER_DEPT_NAME.
- "name of the degree-granting department" → SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME with IS_DEGREE_GRANTING='Y' (dw_4812/dw_3356 precedent).
- "subject code description" → SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC (dw_4490/dw_2210 precedent).
- "average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code" → AVG/VARIANCE over ASCII(SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER) grouped by SUBJECT_CODE.

**3d. Precedent Usage Evidence**
- Same-shape (Math ≥5 enrolled + yearly-average filter + row number) precedents: 2 — dw_4584, dw_4658 — both on LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ⋈ ACADEMIC_TERMS.
- Degree-granting SIS_SUBJECT_CODE stats precedents: dw_4812, dw_3356, dw_4490, dw_2224 (4).
- ASCII aggregation precedent: dw_3969 (1).

## 4. Business Usage
LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED serves library-reserve enrollment questions (parent of LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL); ACADEMIC_TERMS enriches every offering table with term/year attributes; SIS_SUBJECT_CODE resolves subject codes/descriptions for 37 metrics; SIS_DEPARTMENT supplies the degree-granting flag used across catalog/department metrics.

## 5. Coverage Checklist
All Phase 1 entities investigated: tables via `semantic_get` (LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED, SUBJECT_SUMMARY, ACADEMIC_TERMS, SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION) and concept comparisons (SUBJECT_OFFERED, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, STUDENT_DEPARTMENT, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL); metrics dw_4584, dw_4658, dw_4812, dw_3356, dw_4490, dw_3969, dw_2398 via `semantic_get`; dw_2210/dw_1393/dw_4527 via search descriptions; concepts/column-concepts via `semantic_get`; SIS_SUBJECT_CODE via `metrics_by_table`. Note: `mysql_query` failed on every attempt with "Access denied for user 'root'@'localhost'" — data verification was impossible, so the SQL strictly replicates verified precedent SQL structures.

## 6. Recommendation
**6a.** LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED (COURSE_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) ⋈ ACADEMIC_TERMS (TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR) for the base; SIS_DEPARTMENT ⋈ SIS_SUBJECT_CODE for department name/subject code/description and ASCII stats; join library COURSE_NUMBER → SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER restricted to Mathematics.

**6b.** Two CTEs replicate dw_4584 exactly (inner_cte with ROW_NUMBER partitioned by ACADEMIC_YEAR ordered by COURSE_NUMBER; AvgEnrolled per ACADEMIC_YEAR with the same ≥5 filter); a SubjectCodeStats CTE computes AVG/VARIANCE of ASCII(COURSE_NUMBER) per SUBJECT_CODE for degree-granting departments (dw_4812/dw_3969 patterns); final filter `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_enrolled`. No rounding applied. SELECT list has exactly the 11 requested columns in the asked order.

**6c.** *Data*: only LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED has COURSE_NUMBER + NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + OFFER_DEPT_NAME together; SIS_SUBJECT_CODE has COURSE_NUMBER and SUBJECT_CODE at lookup grain (no fan-out when grouped). *Semantic network*: dw_4584 is a verbatim precedent for the first half; column_concept_enrollment_measures decision guide maps "number of enrolled students" to NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS. *Business*: the question is a variant of the "Library Reserve and Enrollment Comprehensive Analysis" category served by these exact tables.

**6d.** Alternative: SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY also has COURSE_NUMBER and NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, but no same-shape precedent uses it for the "≥5 enrolled + yearly average + row number" pattern, whereas dw_4584/dw_4658 both use LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED — the tie-breaker (identical wording precedent) resolves decisively.

**Final SQL** (submitted, case dw_4351): the query above joining inner_cte, AvgEnrolled, SIS_SUBJECT_CODE (Mathematics), and SubjectCodeStats, selecting course number, subject title, enrolled students, term description, academic year, row number, department name, subject code, subject code description, average ASCII, variance of ASCII — ordered by course number.
